disposition_reason: Salted and dried fish products from Omani traditional processing plants were analysed for total mercury (seven products plus processing salt) and lead and cadmium (two shark products).

study.design: survey of salted and dried fish products from traditional processing plants
study.market: collected at dry fish processing plants (freshly produced lots), Oman
study.method: Cd and Pb by ICP-OES with ultrasonic nebulizer after microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion; total Hg by DMA-80
study.lod_text: instrument detection limits: Cd 0.01 mg/kg, Pb 0.02 mg/kg
study.qa: triplicate samples and measurements; no CRM or recovery reported
